methods.name: terminal.send
methods.description: Paste text and press Enter, once nobody has typed for ~3 s; keys a person presses meanwhile are held, then delivered. Refuses a blocked program unless `force`.

methods.name: doc.get
methods.description: Read an opaque JSON document and its version (zero when never written). Optional on selects another machine.

methods.name: doc.set
methods.description: Write an opaque JSON document (at most 1 MiB) if its version still matches. Null deletes the value but retains its version. Persists atomically and emits a doc event.

methods.name: events.subscribe
methods.description: Snapshot of matching terminals, then every fact change in order (created, lost, restarted, keep, finished, removed, status, turn, title, labels, size, doc) as `event` notifications, `heartbeat` every 15 s, and `missed` + fresh snapshot for a subscriber that fell behind.
